title: Sequence log-probability
statement_md:
`token_log_prob(p)` is implemented. Add `sequence_log_prob(probs)`, the log-probability of a whole token sequence under the chain rule.

- return the sum of `token_log_prob(p)` over the sequence
- raise `ValueError` for an empty sequence
- let `token_log_prob` reject probabilities outside `(0, 1]`
- return a `float` and do not mutate `probs`

Do not change `token_log_prob`.
